metadata.name: [JJBA+] Framework
metadata.description:
[JJBA+] core framework. Required by all JJBA+ character mods.
Why a framework? I want to go next level with these TBOI JJBA mods, so this framework will help create new characters and add new (future) mechanics like: - Stand Disc: An item for every stand. - Stand Disc Room: A room like planetary where any character can grab a stand disc from any of the installed JJBA+ character mods, gaining a stand or switching with one already equipped. - Stand Arrow: An item that gives the player a random stand from their installed JJBA+ characters mod. If player already has a stand, then this item will evolve the stand to a Requiem form (with custom evolutions for stands that don't have a canon one). - Broken Stand Arrow: Same as the above item, but as a trinket. - Many more...
What's next? I will be polishing the framework at the same time I fix and polish Jotaro and Kakyoin, so I can have a good base for it. Once I feel the project baseline is fine, I will share the github repo so anybody can use it (maybe you can already work with this mod a little, but I don't recommend doing so till the base release). My idea is to talk and ask permission to migrate other characters to JJBA+ framework or even allow other people to add their own ones to the repo, just to keep track of them and keep compatibilities.
Why now? I dunno, I just wanted. Anyways, this will be a side project I will be working on besides my job and studies, so don't be waiting for weekly updates or so.
Why JJBA+? It's just an easy name to distinguish from other JJBA mods.
Thanks to the following mods that worked as a base for this mod: - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=943074431]Josuke and Crazy Diamond[/url]
